message: So the other night, we had a surprise blackout, and I was feeling pretty proud of my "gloriously over-prepared" self. I grabbed my trusty lantern, powered up my phone with a fully charged power bank, and even had a stash of snacks ready to go. My family teased me about my emergency gear, but let me tell you, sitting in the cozy glow of the lantern with my favorite treats made the whole experience quite delightful! 😄 What’s your go-to tip for staying comfy during a power outage?
